It is frequently used to track bicycle rides, road trips, hiking trips and other outdoor adventures where you want to show your friends and family where you are, or to simply track your adventures for your own pleasure.

There is also a safety aspect of using LocaToWeb. If you have the track running and something happens, your wife, husband and friends can see the exact location of where you are. Key features:

- Share your position to web in real time

- Capture and upload photos while tracking

- Choose your units system (metric/imperial)
- Possible to keep the screen alive while tracking
